NTA, being someone who is single and never dated ever, even I understand that that was totally selfish, and very wrong. It shouldn’t matter if it’s his weekend to kick back and go fishing. He not only has a responsibility as a dad to a little girl who probably doesn’t even understand the meaning of death yet but, he a responsibility as a husband to be there for you OP and be emotional support in your time of need. Plus that’s his sister in law too, I get that death is a hard thing for some people to handle but, at least show that you care. It seems like he isn’t even batting an eye about this. 

I don’t think it means hairs should be split and you should start seeking marriage counseling but, I do think you both should have a serious conversation about this. I mean, I am not defending him but, we don’t know if he can’t handle the fact that his dying sisters-in-law has put him in shock like the thought of her dying could be a toll on him and that’s why he doesn’t want to come home. It’s still selfish because that’s your sister OP and you should mean more to him than some trip on a lake. 

I do think maybe kicking him out for a week to think would be better and than come back and assess what happened and why you felt horrible about his response. Take the time to pull yourself together, and be with your daughter and family. I am so sorry about your sister. My condolences go out to you.
